in_hebrew.name: גִלוּס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew verb 'galah' which means 'to roll away, depart, or go back'. Gilus may be a derivative of this verb and could mean 'backsliding', 'fugitive', or 'renegade'. This name may have been given to someone who had turned away from God or who was in a state of rebellion.

in_greek.name: Γιλούς
in_greek.long_meaning: There is no known Greek equivalent for the name Gilus in the Bible. However, it is possible that the name may have been transliterated as Γιλούς from the Hebrew pronunciation.

in_latin.name: Gilus
in_latin.long_meaning: There is no known Latin equivalent for the name Gilus in the Bible. However, it is possible that the name may have been adopted from the Hebrew or Greek forms.
